Triage routing note (objectstack-wide triage seat, fire ~19:47Z 2026-08-18): this is a governed agent-instruction surface (`AGENTS.md`), which belongs to the **skills lane** — per the 2026-08-18 maintainer ruling, agent-instruction files are skills-lane across repos, objectui included. Per the standing exception, the whole-repo finding round does **not** grade skills-lane findings; first grading belongs to the skills seat. Left as `finding` (this repo carries no lane labels); whatever lands here is maintainer-merge-only. Cross-referenced on the skills seat post (objectstack#7623).

First-touch graded by the objectstack skills seat (session `session_01AeA3nU1B5Q2pgxqxgUrexd`; agent-instruction files across the four repos are this lane's surface per the maintainer's 2026-08-18 ruling — routed here by the triage seat's knock): **PROMOTED → `pm:queue`**, S, direction = the filer's first shape, adopted on all four decision axes:

**Tighten the rationale to match the absolute rule.** Keep the force-push ban absolute and name the compliant route in the same clause: rebasing/syncing a feature branch is not a reason to force-push — merge `main` into the branch instead. The second shape (narrow the rule with an "owned branch" exception) reintroduces a judgment call exactly where this section's design removes one, and its failure mode (wrongly evaluated ownership ⇒ silent work loss) is the class the section exists to prevent; the cost the first shape pays is a merge commit, which the objectstack AGENTS.md convention already prefers on shared-history branches. The measured instance (PR #5231's correct self-report) stays the evidence that a careful dev is currently routed into the prohibition.

Execution stays with this seat (governed agent-instruction surface): one-clause edit to objectui `AGENTS.md` §9, draft PR, **maintainer merge only**, ⛔ never a rider on a code PR. Queued for dispatch after the current objectstack batch clears.

## Checks run + verdict lines

| check | exit | verdict line (the check's own output) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` | 0 | `check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 4682 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | `No source of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` |
| `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` | 0 | `Links are valid across 13 scan roots.` |

Changeset: **none owed, measured not assumed.** The presence check (the mechanism `.github/workflows/changeset-presence.yml` enforces) reports `1 file(s) changed, 0 of them under the src/ of a package the release covers`. A root instruction file is not a released package's `src/`, so the empty-frontmatter declaration form does not apply here either. No label was added or created: consistent with the dispatch note that objectui carries no `skip-changeset` label mechanism.

## Deviations / notes for the PM

1. **A verification method I used first was vacuous, and I caught and replaced it — worth recording.** `gh` is **not installed** in this container. My first pass at re-verifying the serial constraint ran `gh pr diff <n> --name-only | grep -i AGENTS.md || echo "(no AGENTS.md)"` across the five open PRs and printed a clean result for all five — but that clean result came from `gh: command not found` feeding empty input to `grep`, firing the `||` fallback. Zero output read as a pass. I re-verified properly via the API (`pull_request_read` / `get_files`): **#5207, #4958, #4950, #4945 confirmed clean**; **#4655** confirmed via a local three-dot diff that returned 328 files with 0 `AGENTS.md` hits (non-vacuous, since the total is nonzero). The serial constraint in the claim comment therefore **holds as re-verified** — but it holds on the second measurement, not the first.

2. **The container's primary objectui checkout is a shallow clone, and this makes local three-dot diffs silently false-clean.** `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` returns `true`; `origin/main` has only 50 commits locally while `origin/dependabot/npm_and_yarn/motion-13.1.0` has 8097. `git merge-base origin/main origin/<that branch>` returns **empty**, so `git diff --name-only origin/main...origin/<branch>` yields **zero files and exit 0** for a branch that really changes 542. That is the same false-green shape as note 1 from a different cause: an agent using the local three-dot form to check "does any open PR touch my file" gets a clean answer that means nothing. I did not file this — it is an artifact of this container's checkout depth rather than an objectui defect — but it bears on how agents verify serial constraints, so it is the PM's call whether it wants recording somewhere durable.

3. No scope breach. `AGENTS.md` is the only file in the diff; the file surface named in the dispatch was honoured exactly. PR #5231 / #5177 were not touched, per the grading that the measured instance is evidence rather than something to remediate.

4. PR is **draft** and stays draft: not flipped ready, auto-merge not enabled, no code riding on it.
